findings.issue: "bảng trình duyệt" renders "browser pane" with bảng, the word this file uses for a *panel* ("thanh chọn bảng" = panel rail). The corpus translates the browser pane itself as ngăn (ui.browser: "Ngăn này quá hẹp …" = "This pane is too narrow …").
findings.remediation: Changed bảng trình duyệt -> ngăn trình duyệt (one occurrence).

findings.issue: "đang được chọn" / "hãy chọn trình duyệt" render "has focus" / "focus the browser" with chọn (select/choose). The corpus elsewhere says "tiêu điểm bàn phím" for keyboard focus (ui.chat.tags). Selection and focus are not the same thing.
findings.remediation: Not changed: this file already uses "Chọn một ô" for "Focus a field" in shortcuts_for_the_panel_rail…, so changing one string only would make the section internally inconsistent. Raised for a native/UX pass over the file as a whole.

scope: Changed rows only: 8 keys (1 new paragraph + 7 reserved-sentence tails). Key set == English (64/64), ICU placeholder parity, sentence-by-sentence meaning against the .context.json note, register and terminology against the same file and corpus.
